title: Binyamin Asya (the physician)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 99b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.99b.19), Rava said: “For example, those of the house of Binyamin Asya, who say, ‘What benefit have the rabbis ever brought us? They have never permitted a raven to us,’” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Asya is the Aramaic occupational term for a physician. The quoted complaint is attributed to those of his household, and is abbreviated by Hyman.

At 99b, Rava quotes the household of Binyamin the physician, also cited by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=772&lang=en). Their line about permitting ravens continues on [Sanhedrin 100a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.100a.1-2), which also gives Rava’s replies when he rules on animals they bring him.
